method: Within-run ablation; identical data, encoder, query-cache reset and hard filters. Only passage_matching differs.
judgment_method: Developer-authored focal-detail paraphrases verified against the cached source plot text. Relevant IDs are incomplete; not independent human evaluation.
limitations: Seven known movies, selected for available narrative text. These queries are not representative of all users and do not establish general accuracy.
